segments.name: North America
segments.description: Produces containerboard, paperboard, kraft paper and corrugated and consumer packaging from integrated mills and converting plants for customers in the U.S., Canada and Mexico.
segments.evidence: We are one of the largest integrated producers of linerboard, white-top linerboard and containerboard and kraft paper in North America (including the U.S., Canada and Mexico), and we serve primarily corrugated packaging markets.

segments.name: Europe, MEA and APAC
segments.description: Integrated mills and converting plants making containerboard, corrugated and consumer packaging, bag-in-box and other paper grades for European and other customers.
segments.evidence: Our Europe, MEA and APAC segment mill operations consist of 21 mills, and includes a system of mills and box plants that primarily produce a full line of containerboard that is converted into corrugated containers.

segments.name: LATAM
segments.description: Mills and corrugated, folding carton and paper sack plants serving packaging customers across Latin America and the Caribbean.
segments.evidence: We also have folding cartons operations in Costa Rica and El Salvador and the Dominican Republic, paper sack operations in Colombia, Ecuador, Costa Rica and the Dominican Republic, and a recycling plant in Nicaragua.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for paper-based packaging and paper products; we sell through our own sales force, independent representatives and distributors, generally manufacturing to customer orders.
revenueModel.evidence: We market our products through our own sales force.

changes.text: In 2024, following the Combination, the company changed its reportable segments to North America, Europe, MEA and APAC, and LATAM.
changes.evidence: During the third quarter of 2024, following the completion of the Combination, the Company changed its reportable segments and reassessed its reporting units.
